profile.headline: Machine Learning Engineer | Data Scientist
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: Machine learning engineer with varied experience, a solid software background, an eye for design and user experience, and uniquely strong inter-personal skills via two years of full-time volunteer service abroad.

positions.title: AI Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Second hired engineer; oversaw major technical direction during first months.
Deployed AI agents controlling web browsers to submit and retrieve light construction permits.
Utilized various AI tools to generate code, navigate and collect data in web applications.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description: Research includes large language models, reinforcement learning, optimal control.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Feature-engineered, deployed existing similarity classifier, XGBoost, for genealogical records.
Developed novel deep learning classifier (Transformer) to quantify similarity between records.
Took ownership of deploying in-house Transformer model via Flask API using AWS stack.
Developed team's use of Apache Kafka to interface w/ ML models via stream processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Java · Programming · Machine Learning Algorithms · Python (Programming Language) · Jupyter · TensorFlow · PyTorch · Apache Kafka
